name: Hardcoded credential
message: Read credentials from the environment through your settings object, never from a literal.

name: Interpolated SQL
message: Bind parameters instead of interpolating them; an f-string in a query is an injection.

name: Blocking call in async code
message: Use asyncio.sleep or an async client; a blocking call stalls the whole event loop.

name: Bare assert outside tests
message: python -O strips assert. Raise HTTPException or a domain error instead.

name: Secret material committed by path
message: Environment files and key material belong in a secret manager, never in Git. Remove it from the index and rotate the credential.
